column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN test-cycle STEP TABLE: THE TEST-SUITE CYCLE LOOPS REDESIGNED FOR 10x (the cto, 2026-11-05, CTO-522; Lon in the cio's window 16:5x CST, verbatim: "We must speed up the test suite runs by 10x. Yipper skipper!!!" / "CTO is to complete redesign the test suite CYCLE loops."; the design text in .github/skills/suites-and-grading/SKILL.md section 7; the baseline in BASELINE.tsv beside this table).

# harness/scripts/test_design_test_cycle_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step's PROBE, one bash command from S4E_HOME with a 600 s budget: rc 0 GREEN, rc 1 RED, rc 2 could not measure. A step whose instrument does not exist yet reads RED (the missing script is the red), never REFUSED; no probe is satisfied by a deletion alone.

# Adopted from other plans, not duplicated here: box-budget 1 (the LAP line), 3 (the impact set), 4 (the lap by 06:00); box-scheduler 5 (the request SLO), 13, 20, 24; fleet-queue 1 (beanstalkd), 10-15 (the tick); batch-grader 5 and 7 (the harness road). A step here names them in depends_on_plans.

column5: awk -F'\t' '!/^#/ {n++; if ($2+0<=0) bad++} END {exit !(n>=12 && !bad)}' corpus/tests/shared/test_cycle/BASELINE.tsv && grep -qE '^rows_per_hour=[0-9]+' /home/resources/progress/BOX.state && echo "baseline rows: $(grep -vc '^#' corpus/tests/shared/test_cycle/BASELINE.tsv); live rows_per_hour=$(grep -oP '^rows_per_hour=\K[0-9]+' /home/resources/progress/BOX.state)"

bash harness/scripts/util_queue.sh stats grade | grep -E '^TUBE grade ' && python3 harness/scripts/util_grade_job.py --probe | grep -E '^GRADE_JOB suite=[a-z0-9-]+ cell=(core|shell:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+|chunk:[0-9]+|entry:[^ ]+) modes=m3,m4 tree=[0-9a-f]{7,} pri=(100|200|500|900) ttr_s=[0-9]+'

T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-coo}/tc2.XXXXXX) && strace -f -qq -e trace=execve -o $T/x python3 harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py smoke RPOS --tables tests/snobol4 --entries "pos_rpos_branch_1 arb_pos_rpos_branch_1 arb_pos_rpos_branch_2 arbno_pos_rpos_branch_33 arbno_pos_rpos_branch_34 arbno_pos_rpos_branch_35 arbno_pos_rpos_branch_36 arbno_pos_rpos_branch_37 arbno_pos_rpos_branch_38 arbno_pos_rpos_branch_6" --modes m3,m4 > $T/out 2>&1 && grep -q 'entries=10 all_pass=10' $T/out && n=$(grep -c 'execve("[^"]*/scrip"' $T/x) && echo "scrip launches for ten entries in both modes: $n (23 today: two a program plus the freshness probe, MEASURED 2026-11-05)" && test "$n" -le 4

test -x /usr/bin/ld.gold && grep -q 'fuse-ld=gold' harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py && T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-coo}/tc3.XXXXXX) && printf "\tOUTPUT = 'hi'\nEND\n" > $T/h.sno && SNO_LIB=SCRIP/inc SCRIP/scrip --compile $T/h.sno > $T/h.s && gcc -c $T/h.s -o $T/h.o && perf stat -e instructions:u -x, -o $T/p gcc $T/h.o -L SCRIP/out -lscrip_rt -lm -Wl,-rpath,$PWD/SCRIP/out -fuse-ld=gold -o $T/h && i=$(grep instructions $T/p | cut -d, -f1) && echo "gold link: $i instructions (bfd 80,000,000 MEASURED 2026-11-05)" && test $i -lt 50000000

test -s harness/scripts/s4e_grade_worker.sh && n=$(systemctl --user list-units 's4e-grade-worker@*' --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -c ' running ') && w=$(grep -oP '^grader_width=\K[0-9]+' /home/resources/progress/BOX.state) && echo "workers running: $n; controller width: $w" && test "$n" -gt 0 && test "$n" = "$w" && ! ps -eo args | grep -qx 'bash loop8.sh'

test -s /home/resources/progress/FEED.tsv && h=$(git -C SCRIP rev-parse --short=9 origin/main) && grep -P "^(smoke|impact)\t${h:0:7}" /home/resources/progress/FEED.tsv | awk -F'\t' '$6+0 <= 60' | cut -f1 | sort -u | paste -sd, | grep -qx 'impact,smoke' && grep -qP '^lap\t' /home/resources/progress/FEED.tsv && echo "FEED.tsv: smoke and impact for $h within 60 s; a lap feed on record"

bad=0; for t in corpus/tests/snobol4/ALL.csv corpus/tests/icon/ALL.csv corpus/tests/prolog/ALL.csv corpus/tests/pascal/ALL.csv corpus/tests/raku/ALL.csv corpus/tests/snocone/ALL.csv corpus/tests/rebus/ALL.csv $(ls corpus/packages/*/*/ALL.csv); do head -1 $t | grep -q 'timeout_s' || { echo "no timeout_s column: $t"; bad=1; }; done; test $bad = 0 && grep -q 'timeout_s' harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py && python3 harness/scripts/util_grade_cell.py --night-only | grep -E '^NIGHT_ONLY over_s=300 programs=[0-9]+ of [0-9]+'

test -s harness/scripts/lib_grade_cell.sh && ! ps -eo args | grep -qx 'bash loop8.sh' && ! ps -eo args | grep -qE '^bash (\S+/)?tier1\.sh' && awk -F'\t' '$1=="lap" && $3=="done" && $4 ~ /tube/' /home/resources/progress/LAP.tsv | grep -q . && echo "a lap done through the tube: $(awk -F'\t' '$1=="lap" && $3=="done"' /home/resources/progress/LAP.tsv | tail -1)"

python3 harness/scripts/util_seat_census.py --test-cycle-acceptance 86400 corpus/tests/shared/test_cycle/BASELINE.tsv | grep -E '^TEST_CYCLE_ACCEPTANCE .*entries_per_hour=[0-9]+ x_baseline=(1[0-9]|[2-9][0-9])[.0-9]* instr_per_entry=[0-9]+ .*request_p50_min=([0-9]|10) .*idle_with_ready_min=0 hand_restarts=0'

test -s harness/scripts/SUITE_RUNNERS.tsv && python3 harness/scripts/util_suite_runners.py --check | grep -E '^SUITE_RUNNERS keys=[0-9]+ packages=[0-9]+ missing_runner=0 unlisted_suites=0' && bash harness/scripts/s4e_grade_worker.sh --probe-package | grep -E '^GRADE_WORKER package=1 runner=[a-z0-9_]+(_suite\.sh|_scoreboard\.sh --run) launches=1 modes=m3,m4 deleted=1'
